first_biological_access.list_IDs: exact frozen 147 pilot list_IDs only from the future committed v1.50 router result

entity_species_response.entity_unit: one of the 99 frozen pilot whole-island entity_IDs
entity_species_response.certain_presence: at least one returned row for any eligible list_ID of the entity with native==1, questionable==0 and quest_native==0
entity_species_response.uncertain: no certain presence but at least one returned row for the work_ID on an eligible entity list with questionable!=0 or quest_native!=0
entity_species_response.checklist_absence: no returned row for that work_ID across any eligible list_ID of the entity
entity_species_response.absence_claim_boundary: checklist absence in complete/native/suit_geo GIFT lists; do not claim perfect biological nondetection

fixed_species_universe.candidate_species: work_IDs with at least one certain presence in pilot
fixed_species_universe.block_presence: at least one certain-presence entity in that frozen pilot archipelago
fixed_species_universe.block_absence: no certain presence and at least one known checklist-absence entity in that frozen pilot archipelago
fixed_species_universe.if_above_maximum: select 2000 smallest SHA256('Structural-GIFT-species-v1.51|'+work_ID), tie by numeric/string work_ID

pilot_quality_gate.missing_or_invalid_work_ID: row excluded from fixed species construction and counted in receipt; it cannot create a presence or absence for another work_ID
pilot_quality_gate.qualifying_species_below_100: terminal STOP; confirmatory access remains sealed
pilot_quality_gate.next_after_clean_pilot: preserve a compact entity-by-fixed-species pilot matrix including unknown mask, then freeze R3/C models and all confirmatory predictions in a separate revision
